prompt:

Keep Image 1's camera position, framing, walls, windows, doorways and furniture, traced in outline; only add the people.
Image 1: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, with no people
Image 2: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S3

Do not copy a sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. Each person appears once, whole and at natural scale for the place, on the furniture and floor of Image 1, facing the way the start says.
Only two people appear: Natalie and Sebastian. Nobody else is there.
At the start: Natalie stands in the bedroom doorway on the back wall in her camisole, sleep shorts and open robe, one hand on the door. Sebastian, in his white undershirt, stands one step in front of her outside the bedroom door. His phone lies face down on the round coffee table beside the signed agreement; the pillow lies at the front-door end of the couch.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
